reader_summary.headline: Ashby Monk is the Executive & Research Director of the Stanford Research Initiative on Long-Term Investing.
reader_summary.overview: Ashby Monk is the Executive & Research Director of the Stanford Research Initiative on Long-Term Investing. Ashby has studied and advised the largest asset owners in the world for more than twenty years with a particular interest in how to improve outcomes for their beneficiaries and the world.. Ash also serves as the Head of Research at Addepar, a fintech company that helps investors make smarter decisions.

key_points.text: Ashby has studied and advised the largest asset owners in the world for more than twenty years with a particular interest in how to improve outcomes for their beneficiaries and the world..
He has twice appeared on the show – as the 29th guest back in 2017 and again two years ago – and those conversations are replayed in the feed..
Our conversation starts with a recent paper Ashby published called Investor Identity: The Ultimate Driver of Returns.
